; kosync-native-reader: KOReader progress sync inside the built-in EPUB reader.
;
; - Toolbar "more" menu (three dots, EPUBs only): "Progress sync" opens a panel with
;   push / pull the current book, status, and server + account settings.
; - Opening an EPUB pulls automatically: if another device saved a newer position,
;   the reader jumps there (offline: a note kosync-bridge fetched earlier is used).
; - Closing an EPUB pushes the current position automatically.
; - Sync results and errors are shown in a short notice at the bottom of the screen.
;
; All network work is done by kosync-bridge (systemd service). The panel talks to it
; through small JSON files (cmd/ -> result/) using QML's XMLHttpRequest on file:// URLs,
; which xovi's qt-resource-rebuilder enables (QML_XHR_ALLOW_FILE_READ/WRITE=1).

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property var kosyncHost: null
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/SettingsMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool > Component#settingsComponent > ColumnLayout#content
        LOCATE AFTER Repeater#utilityTools
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                objectName: "kosyncSettingsMenuItem"
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: root.documentType === "ebook" && !!root.toolbar.kosyncHost
                label: qsTr("Progress sync")
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/cloud"
                onClicked: {
                    root.toolbar.closeFoldout();
                    root.toolbar.kosyncHost.kosyncOpenPanel();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > Item#_uiContainer > Toolbar#toolbar
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            kosyncHost: root
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE FocusScope > Item#_uiContainer
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: kosyncPanel
                objectName: "kosyncPanel"
                anchors.fill: parent
                visible: false
                z: 10000

                readonly property string base: "file:///home/root/.local/share/kosync-bridge/"
                property bool busy: false
                property string message: ""
                property var status: ({})
                property var pending: ({})   // request id -> { callback, tries }
                // Shown (hidden as dots) in the password field when logged in: the real
                // password is never stored, only KOReader's md5 key.
                readonly property string savedPassword: "\u0001saved-password\u0001"

                function passwordRequest(action) {
                    const pw = kosyncPasswordField.text;
                    const req = { action: action, server: kosyncServerField.text, username: kosyncUserField.text };
                    if (pw === savedPassword) {
                        req.keep_key = true;
                    } else {
                        req.password = pw;
                    }
                    return req;
                }

                function showSavedPassword() {
                    kosyncPasswordField.text = status.logged_in ? savedPassword : "";
                }

                function readJson(url, callback) {
                    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
                        if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                            return;
                        }
                        let value = null;
                        try {
                            value = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                        } catch (e) {
                            value = null;
                        }
                        callback(value);
                    };
                    xhr.open("GET", url);
                    xhr.send();
                }

                function writeJson(url, value) {
                    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    xhr.open("PUT", url);
                    xhr.send(JSON.stringify(value));
                }

                function refreshStatus() {
                    readJson(base + "status.json", function(st) {
                        kosyncPanel.status = st || {};
                        if (!kosyncPasswordField.activeFocus) {
                            kosyncPanel.showSavedPassword();
                        }
                        if (st && !kosyncServerField.activeFocus) {
                            kosyncServerField.text = st.server || "";
                        }
                        if (st && !kosyncUserField.activeFocus && kosyncUserField.text === "") {
                            kosyncUserField.text = st.username || "";
                        }
                    });
                }

                // Send a request to kosync-bridge; callback(result) gets
                // { ok, message, ... } or a timeout error.
                function call(request, callback) {
                    if (!request) {
                        return;
                    }
                    const id = Date.now().toString() + "-" + Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000);
                    pending[id] = { callback: callback || null, tries: 0 };
                    writeJson(base + "cmd/" + id + ".json", request);
                    kosyncPoll.start();
                }

                // Panel buttons: one at a time, result shown in the panel.
                function send(request, callback) {
                    if (busy || !request) {
                        return;
                    }
                    busy = true;
                    message = qsTr("Working…");
                    call(request, function(result) {
                        kosyncPanel.busy = false;
                        kosyncPanel.message = result.message || (result.ok ? qsTr("Done.") : qsTr("Failed."));
                        if (callback) {
                            callback(result);
                        }
                        kosyncPanel.refreshStatus();
                    });
                }

                function bookRequest(action, auto) {
                    if (!root.document || root.document.fileType !== Document.Ebook) {
                        return null;
                    }
                    return { action: action, doc: "" + root.document.id, auto: !!auto,
                             page: root.currentPage, pages: root.document.pageCount };
                }

                Timer {
                    id: kosyncPoll
                    interval: 700
                    repeat: true
                    onTriggered: {
                        const ids = Object.keys(kosyncPanel.pending);
                        if (ids.length === 0) {
                            stop();
                            return;
                        }
                        ids.forEach(function(id) {
                            const entry = kosyncPanel.pending[id];
                            if (!entry) {
                                return;
                            }
                            entry.tries++;
                            if (entry.tries > 60) {
                                delete kosyncPanel.pending[id];
                                if (entry.callback) {
                                    entry.callback({ ok: false, message: qsTr("Sync failed: kosync-bridge isn't answering. Is the service running?") });
                                }
                                return;
                            }
                            kosyncPanel.readJson(kosyncPanel.base + "result/" + id + ".json", function(res) {
                                if (res && kosyncPanel.pending[id]) {
                                    delete kosyncPanel.pending[id];
                                    if (entry.callback) {
                                        entry.callback(res);
                                    }
                                }
                            });
                        });
                    }
                }

                // tap outside the card closes the panel
                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    onClicked: kosyncPanel.visible = false
                }

                Rectangle {
                    id: kosyncCard
                    width: Math.min(parent.width - 60, 820)
                    height: kosyncColumn.implicitHeight + 60
                    anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                    y: 150
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 3
                    radius: 16

                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                    }

                    Column {
                        id: kosyncColumn
                        x: 30
                        y: 30
                        width: kosyncCard.width - 60
                        spacing: 16

                        ArkControls.Title {
                            type: ArkControls.Title.Large
                            text: qsTr("Progress sync")
                        }

                        ArkControls.Label {
                            width: parent.width
                            wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                            type: ArkControls.Label.Medium
                            text: kosyncPanel.status.logged_in
                                  ? qsTr("Logged in as %1 on %2").arg(kosyncPanel.status.username).arg(kosyncPanel.status.server)
                                  : qsTr("Not logged in. Enter your account below.")
                        }

                        Row {
                            width: parent.width
                            spacing: 20
                            ArkControls.Button {
                                type: ArkTokens.Button.primary
                                text: qsTr("Push")
                                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/cloud_upload"
                                width: (parent.width - parent.spacing) / 2
                                enabled: !kosyncPanel.busy && !!kosyncPanel.status.logged_in
                                onClicked: kosyncPanel.send(kosyncPanel.bookRequest("push"))
                            }
                            ArkControls.Button {
                                type: ArkTokens.Button.primary
                                text: qsTr("Pull")
                                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/cloud_download"
                                width: (parent.width - parent.spacing) / 2
                                enabled: !kosyncPanel.busy && !!kosyncPanel.status.logged_in
                                onClicked: kosyncPanel.send(kosyncPanel.bookRequest("pull"), function(res) {
                                    if (res.ok && typeof res.page === "number" && root.document) {
                                        sceneView.goToPage(res.page);
                                    }
                                })
                            }
                        }

                        ArkControls.Label {
                            width: parent.width
                            wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                            type: ArkControls.Label.LargeStrong
                            text: kosyncPanel.message
                            visible: text !== ""
                        }

                        Rectangle {
                            width: parent.width
                            height: 2
                            color: "black"
                        }

                        ArkControls.Label {
                            type: ArkControls.Label.LargeStrong
                            text: qsTr("Server settings")
                        }

                        ArkControls.Label {
                            type: ArkControls.Label.Medium
                            text: qsTr("Server")
                        }
                        ArkControls.InputField {
                            id: kosyncServerField
                            width: parent.width
                            clip: true
                            inputMethodHints: Qt.ImhNoAutoUppercase | Qt.ImhUrlCharactersOnly | Qt.ImhNoPredictiveText
                        }

                        ArkControls.Label {
                            type: ArkControls.Label.Medium
                            text: qsTr("Username")
                        }
                        ArkControls.InputField {
                            id: kosyncUserField
                            width: parent.width
                            clip: true
                            inputMethodHints: Qt.ImhNoAutoUppercase | Qt.ImhNoPredictiveText
                        }

                        ArkControls.Label {
                            type: ArkControls.Label.Medium
                            text: qsTr("Password")
                        }
                        ArkControls.InputField {
                            id: kosyncPasswordField
                            width: parent.width
                            clip: true
                            echoMode: TextInput.Password
                            inputMethodHints: Qt.ImhNoAutoUppercase | Qt.ImhNoPredictiveText | Qt.ImhSensitiveData
                            // tapping the saved (hidden) password clears it for typing a new one
                            onActiveFocusChanged: {
                                if (activeFocus && text === kosyncPanel.savedPassword) {
                                    text = "";
                                } else if (!activeFocus && text === "") {
                                    kosyncPanel.showSavedPassword();
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        Row {
                            width: parent.width
                            spacing: 20
                            ArkControls.Button {
                                type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                text: qsTr("Log in")
                                width: (parent.width - 2 * parent.spacing) / 3
                                enabled: !kosyncPanel.busy
                                onClicked: kosyncPanel.send(kosyncPanel.passwordRequest("login"))
                            }
                            ArkControls.Button {
                                type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                text: qsTr("Register")
                                width: (parent.width - 2 * parent.spacing) / 3
                                enabled: !kosyncPanel.busy
                                onClicked: kosyncPanel.send(kosyncPanel.passwordRequest("register"))
                            }
                            ArkControls.Button {
                                type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                text: qsTr("Log out")
                                width: (parent.width - 2 * parent.spacing) / 3
                                enabled: !kosyncPanel.busy && !!kosyncPanel.status.logged_in
                                onClicked: kosyncPanel.send({ action: "logout" })
                            }
                        }

                        ArkControls.Button {
                            type: ArkTokens.Button.tertiary
                            text: qsTr("Close")
                            width: parent.width
                            onClicked: kosyncPanel.visible = false
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Rectangle {
                id: kosyncNotice
                objectName: "kosyncNotice"
                property alias text: kosyncNoticeLabel.text
                visible: false
                z: 10001
                width: Math.min(parent.width - 60, 860)
                height: kosyncNoticeLabel.implicitHeight + 40
                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                anchors.bottomMargin: 60
                color: "white"
                border.color: "black"
                border.width: 3
                radius: 16

                function show(message) {
                    if (!message) {
                        return;
                    }
                    text = message;
                    visible = true;
                    kosyncNoticeTimer.restart();
                }

                ArkControls.Label {
                    id: kosyncNoticeLabel
                    x: 20
                    width: parent.width - 40
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                    type: ArkControls.Label.Medium
                }

                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    onClicked: kosyncNotice.visible = false
                }

                Timer {
                    id: kosyncNoticeTimer
                    interval: 5000
                    onTriggered: kosyncNotice.visible = false
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        RENAME openDocument TO _kosyncOrigOpenDocument
        RENAME close TO _kosyncOrigClose
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            function kosyncOpenPanel() {
                kosyncPanel.message = "";
                kosyncPanel.showSavedPassword();
                kosyncPanel.refreshStatus();
                kosyncPanel.visible = true;
            }

            function openDocument(documentToOpen) {
                root._kosyncOrigOpenDocument(documentToOpen);
                root._kosyncApplyPull(documentToOpen);
                root._kosyncAutoPull(documentToOpen);
            }

            function close() {
                root._kosyncAutoPush();
                root._kosyncOrigClose();
            }

            // Push the position of the EPUB that is being closed.
            function _kosyncAutoPush() {
                const request = kosyncPanel.bookRequest("push", true);
                if (!request) {
                    return;
                }
                kosyncPanel.call(request, function(res) {
                    if (!res.ok) {
                        // shown if another document is open by then; kosync-bridge retries later
                        console.warn("[kosync-native-reader] push on close: " + res.message);
                        kosyncNotice.show(res.message + " " + qsTr("It will be retried automatically."));
                    }
                });
            }

            // Ask the server for a newer position when an EPUB is opened.
            function _kosyncAutoPull(doc) {
                if (!doc || doc.fileType !== Document.Ebook) {
                    return;
                }
                const request = kosyncPanel.bookRequest("pull", true);
                if (!request) {
                    return;
                }
                kosyncPanel.call(request, function(res) {
                    if (root.document !== doc) {
                        return;
                    }
                    if (!res.ok) {
                        kosyncNotice.show(res.message);
                        return;
                    }
                    if (typeof res.page === "number" && res.page !== root.currentPage) {
                        sceneView.goToPage(res.page);
                        kosyncNotice.show(res.message);
                    }
                });
            }

            function _kosyncApplyPull(doc) {
                if (!doc || doc.fileType !== Document.Ebook) {
                    return;
                }
                const url = "file:///home/root/.local/share/kosync-bridge/pull/" + doc.id + ".json";
                const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
                    if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                        return;
                    }
                    let note = null;
                    try {
                        note = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                    } catch (e) {
                        return;
                    }
                    if (!note || typeof note.page !== "number" || root.document !== doc) {
                        return;
                    }
                    console.warn("[kosync-native-reader] synced position: page " + note.page + " from " + note.device);
                    if (note.page !== root.currentPage) {
                        sceneView.goToPage(note.page);
                    }
                    const clear = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    clear.open("PUT", url);
                    clear.send("{}");
                };
                xhr.open("GET", url);
                xhr.send();
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
